evidence.observation: Reuses host-supplied instructions, limits reads to task-relevant material, maps context layers, and explicitly rejects preloading unrelated documentation and skill bodies.

Direct lookup is preferred for known files and short checks; delegation is conditional on expected context reduction exceeding overhead; one scout is the default, and the delegation reference is deferred until delegation is chosen. Bounded direct fallback is explicit when delegation is unavailable.
Provides bounded inputs, depth guidance, inspection-only scope, stopping criteria, and targeted reuse/follow-up rather than repeating whole searches.
Limits context to relevant sources and loads the question reference only in the interview flow; explicit answers are checkpointed before continuation.

no_finding_evidence.assessment: No source-confirmed avoidable repeated read was established. Similar reminders to reuse supplied project instructions are necessary because these are independently invocable workflows; removing one would make other entry points less self-contained.

evidence.observation: Harness canonical skill directs route discovery and user choice before delegation, distinguishes requested from effective model, and avoids silently inheriting a larger parent model.
Requires scoped assignments, freshness, and inspection-only work; no extra delegation authority is implied.
Requires one material question at a time, current guess, native tool, and immediate checkpoint of explicit answers.
Uses callable host-native schema, treats pending/non-answer states as unanswered, and preserves explicit confirmation and recovery semantics.
Codex counterpart uses its host-specific model guidance and retains user-supported override and unknown-effective-route caveats.
Claude counterpart uses its host-specific model guidance and retains user-supported override and unknown-effective-route caveats.
Codex uses request_user_input; tool-schema inspection, one-at-a-time interaction, and conversational fallback are preserved.
Claude uses AskUserQuestion with the same interaction safeguards and fallback.
Harness export uses ask_user_question and preserves the canonical question and fallback behavior.

no_finding_evidence.assessment: Host-native variation is intentional and preserved. No evidence supports consolidating route choice or question consent without weakening the distinct host contracts.
